name: f2-hbm-nch8-rtl
label: measured
description: The repository's own F2 HBM build (targets f2-hbm: S=1, NCH=8 channels on 8 HBM pseudo-channels, 200 MHz core, 400 MHz TMEM, 450 MHz HBM AXI; docs/f2_hbm.md) as the Verilator perf runs evaluate it: otpu_native_dram(NCH=8) in front of sim/verilator/otpu_native_mem.sv with --lat core cycles of read latency. Synthesized (SynthCL) but not placed, routed or run on a board: an RTL configuration, not an image.

pin.synth_receipt: docs/f2_hbm.md 'Synthesis' at 4bef3758 (f2-hbm 174,919 LUTs, WNS +0.154 ns post-synthesis estimate)

refresh.note: otpu_native_mem has no refresh; the HBM IP's is not modelled in Verilator

uncertain: loaded HBM latency (300-400 ns is the design note, not a measurement)
bank conflicts (the sim model has no banks unless +axi_dram=1)
